notes: Ablation arms for the minute-feature predictor (plan 2026-10-09-data-windows.md, 'Feature families and selection'). `arms`: each is the list of KEPT families, passed as the `families` param of crypto_trading.minute_features:MinuteFeatures; a dropped family loses every column with its `<family>__` prefix and nothing else, so labels, `meta__scale` (the label divisor, in no family and not a model input) and the row set are identical in every arm. `scale_arms`: each is the list of KEPT scales (minutes). An arm drops EVERY column that carries that many minutes: the `scales` columns (ret, trend, vol rms/hl/jump, the xasset pair change) and the EWMA half-life (`ewma_half_lives`), range window (`range_windows`) and taker window (`taker_windows`) of the same minutes, so minus_scale_60 removes vol__ewma_60, xasset__ewma_60, range__hi_60, range__lo_60 and flow__taker_60 as well. The lanes get those lists from FeatureGroups.arm_params (a test pins the manifests to it); a window that is not a minute of the grid stays in every arm. The row set stays the same because `history_minutes` (default: the widest scale of the grid) fixes the warm-up, so leave it unset, and because every arm passes `taker_check_windows` (the full taker list) so an impossible taker-buy volume is refused over the same bars. Run `all`, then each `minus_*` arm, then each `minus_scale_*` arm on the same folds and seeds; keep a family or scale only if dropping it hurts beyond fold noise. The two ablations are separate runs: do not combine a family arm with a scale arm. `xasset` is the other asset's ret/vol columns plus the pair log ratio, a separate family from `ret`/`vol`. `holiday` needs the exchange_calendars library. `bvol` is an ablation family (26 missing days). tests/test_minute_features.py pins both lists to the node's declared FAMILIES and DEFAULT_SCALES, so a renamed or added family or scale fails there until this file follows.
